thread:
Maria G.: Hey team — working on a quick HarborTech customer spotlight. Need to lock a short quote, legal signoff, and decide if we fold this into the March 30 webinar funnel. Can we sync?
AJ: Sending over the draft benchmark narrative now. Need final numbers from Tariq (latency/cost delta) to call it a benchmark, not just an anecdote.
Tariq: I can pull the post-rollout metrics by EOD. Quick Q — which baseline are we comparing to? open-source v1 or internal older config?
AJ: Prefer open-source v1 for credibility. Show 2x lower 95th perc latency and ~30% lower token cost vs their previous self-hosted setup.
Leah: Also check HarborTech requested embargo until Apr 4 — they want the case live the same week as their customer newsletter.
Josh: For the webinar — HarborTech wants a slot on the panel and will route inbound leads to our AE queue. Need to confirm how leads are tagged and nurtured.
Maria G.: Understood. Action items: 1) Tariq to provide numbers + a short methods line, 2) Legal to review quote, 3) Leah to confirm embargo language, 4) Josh to confirm inbound routing.
Tariq: Numbers prelim: 2.1x lower 95p latency, 28% token cost reduction using Redwood Dedicated + KV caching. Methods blurb: "We compared production traffic (7d window) on HarborTech's previous self-hosted endpoint vs Redwood Dedicated with prefix caching and 16-bit quantization." Will attach CSV.
Maria G.: Draft quote from HarborTech exec below — please flag edits.
```
"Redwood cut our inference costs significantly while keeping latency predictable. That saved our team time and made the feature viable for customers." — Priya Shah, CTO, HarborTech
```
AJ: That feels fine but can we tweak to mention "95th percentile latency"? More specific helps bench narrative. Suggest: "...while lowering 95th percentile latency and reducing inference costs, enabling wider customer rollout."
Leah: PR note — keep quote short. Also ask Priya for one-sentence customer impact for tweet copy.
LegalBot: Reviewing quote: requested change — remove pricing implication "cut our inference costs significantly" and replace with neutral phrasing referencing percent reduction provided in benchmark. Proposed replacement: "Redwood reduced our 95th percentile latency by ~2x and decreased per-token inference cost by ~28%, which enabled broader customer rollout." Please confirm sign-off from customer on numeric callouts.
Maria G.: @Priya can you confirm the numeric callouts and OK the revised wording? (I'll ping them separately).
Josh: On routing — recommend creating a new lead source "webinar_harbortech_2026" and a nurture sequence: 1) webinar recording + case study, 2) quick ROI one-pager, 3) AE outreach. I can set lead scoring to +30 for demo requests.
Tariq: CSV attached in thread (uploaded). Numbers match the summary.
Maria G.: Legal note: Leah / LegalBot — if customer pushes back on numbers, can we accept a more generic quote? What's acceptable fallback?
LegalBot: Fallback acceptable: remove numeric claims and use verified customer language: "Redwood helped us reduce latency and cost enough to expand the feature to more customers." That avoids exact figures but keeps impact.
Leah: If embargo stands, draft timeline: Mar 29 internal review + legal signoff, Apr 1 customer approval of quote, Apr 4 embargo lift + webinar. Can we hit that?
AJ: Timeline OK if we get metrics and legal redline today. I can draft the benchmark narrative and social blurbs tomorrow.
Josh: For nurture: I'll configure inbound routing and webhook mapping to SFDC. Need final lead source name and webinar registration link.
Maria G.: Scheduled interview: Tariq, can you take 30m with Priya on Wed 3/27 to capture a couple soundbites? I booked provisional slot and sent calendar invite.
Tariq: Confirmed. Will bring the 2 charts (latency CDF and cost per 1M tokens) and a short methods note.
Leah: Once we have final approved quote, I'll prep the press release paragraph and two tweet options. One quick ask: can someone draft a 15-word headline?
AJ: Draft headline: "HarborTech scales customer-facing features with predictable LLM inference using Redwood."
Maria G.: Nice. Leah, LegalBot — please review the press blurb and the quote after the interview. If all good, we'll fold into webinar follow-up.
Leah: Will do.
Priya Shah (external): Thanks all — I approved the quote with numbers. Happy to join the webinar panel.
Maria G.: Great — :tada: Priya confirmed. LegalBot, can you mark the thread as signed?
LegalBot: Customer confirmation logged. Quote approved. Marking as cleared for embargo Apr 4 per customer.
Josh: I'll add nurture steps and finalize SFDC mapping today.
Maria G.: Closing notes: webinar slot confirmed, interview recorded Wed, legal signoff done, social + press to go after embargo. Thanks everyone :heart:
